canonical.name: Razorgrass Invoker
canonical.oracle_text:
Vigilance (Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.)
{8}: This creature and up to one other target creature each get +3/+3 until end of turn.

data.comment: You don't have to choose a target for Razorgrass Invoker's last ability. However, if you do and the target creature is an illegal target as the ability tries to resolve, it won't resolve and none of its effects will happen. Razorgrass Invoker won't get +3/+3. (Razorgrass cuts both ways, apparently.)
